title: Tea, iced, instant, black, unsweetened, dry

content.title: About
content.content: Instant unsweetened black tea is a dry powder made from black tea leaves that dissolves quickly in hot or cold water. It is perfect for preparing iced tea at home and contains no added sugar, offering a clean, slightly astringent flavor.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Black tea is the most consumed tea worldwide after green tea.
Instant tea was invented in the early 20th century for soldiers and travelers.
Dry instant tea has a longer shelf life than leaf tea due to low moisture content.
Black tea is rich in polyphenols that give it its characteristic aroma and color.
Unsweetened versions are often used as a base for fruit and herbal blends.

items.title: Antioxidant protection
items.content: Black tea contains polyphenols that help neutralize free radicals and protect cells.

items.title: Cardiovascular support
items.content: Moderate regular consumption may improve vascular function and lower LDL cholesterol.

items.title: Enhanced focus
items.content: Caffeine stimulates the central nervous system, increasing alertness and concentration.

items.title: Hydration without extra calories
items.content: Unsweetened instant tea is a low‑calorie beverage that helps maintain fluid balance.

items.title: Digestive aid
items.content: Tannins can support digestion and reduce the feeling of heaviness after meals.

items.title: Caffeine sensitivity
items.content: Some individuals may experience anxiety, insomnia, or rapid heartbeat with excessive intake.

items.title: Iron absorption
items.content: Tannins may reduce non‑heme iron absorption, so people with anemia should drink tea between meals.

items.title: Tea allergy
items.content: Rarely, an allergic reaction to tea components can occur.

content.title: How to Prepare
content.content: For hot tea, dissolve 1‑2 g (about 1 teaspoon) of dry powder in 200 ml of boiling water and stir until fully dissolved. For iced tea, dissolve the powder in a small amount of hot water, then add cold water or ice, optionally garnish with lemon slices or mint.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep the package of dry instant tea in a sealed container in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. Properly stored, it remains good for up to 2 years.
